1	import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
2	import { z } from 'zod'
3	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
4	import { logAuditAction } from '@/lib/audit'
5	import { createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
6	import { RPC, type TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
7	import { adminExportRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
8	import { requirePlatformAdmin } from '@/lib/admin/require-platform-admin'
9	import { getClientIp } from '@/lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip'
10	
11	const BodySchema = z.object({
12	  studioId: z.string().uuid(),
13	  year: z.number().int().min(2024).max(2099),
14	  quarter: z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2), z.literal(3), z.literal(4)]),
15	})
16	
17	export async function POST(req: NextRequest): Promise<Response> {
18	  const auth = await requirePlatformAdmin(req)
19	  if (auth instanceof NextResponse) return auth
20	
21	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
22	  const rl = await adminExportRatelimit.limit(ip)
23	  if (!rl.success) {
24	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'rate_limited' }, { status: 429 })
25	  }
26	
27	  let body: unknown
28	  try {
29	    body = await req.json()
30	  } catch {
31	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'invalid_json' }, { status: 400 })
32	  }
33	
34	  const parsed = BodySchema.safeParse(body)
35	  if (!parsed.success) {
36	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'validation', issues: parsed.error.issues }, { status: 400 })
37	  }
38	
39	  const supabase = createServiceRoleClient()
40	
41	  // §S13.3 — tax_oss_quarterly_export not yet in generated types.ts; cast to untyped rpc.
42	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as (
43	    fn: string,
44	    args: Record<string, unknown>,
45	  ) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>
46	
47	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.TAX_OSS_QUARTERLY_EXPORT, {
48	    p_studio_id: parsed.data.studioId,
49	    p_year: parsed.data.year,
50	    p_quarter: parsed.data.quarter,
51	  })
52	
53	  if (error) {
54	    logger.error({ studio_id: parsed.data.studioId, err: error }, 'tax_oss_quarterly_export RPC failed')
55	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'export_failed' }, { status: 500 })
56	  }
57	
58	  const result = data as TaxOssQuarterlyExportResult
59	
60	  // Build CSV
61	  const lines: string[] = []
62	  lines.push('jurisdiction,amount_collected_cents,amount_remitted_cents,amount_outstanding_cents,registration_status')
63	  for (const j of result.jurisdictions) {
64	    lines.push(
65	      [
66	        j.jurisdiction,
67	        j.amount_collected_cents,
68	        j.amount_remitted_cents,
69	        j.amount_outstanding_cents,
70	        j.registration_status ?? '',
71	      ].join(','),
72	    )
73	  }
74	  lines.push(`TOTAL_EU_COLLECTED,${result.total_eu_collected_cents},,,`)
75	  lines.push(`TOTAL_EU_OUTSTANDING,${result.total_eu_outstanding_cents},,,`)
76	  const csv = lines.join('\n') + '\n'
77	
78	  await logAuditAction(
79	    auth.userId,
80	    'admin_tax_oss_export',
81	    { type: 'studio', id: parsed.data.studioId },
82	    { year: parsed.data.year, quarter: parsed.data.quarter, period: result.period },
83	    parsed.data.studioId,
84	  )
85	
86	  return new Response(csv, {
87	    status: 200,
88	    headers: {
89	      'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
90	      'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="oss-${parsed.data.studioId}-${result.period}.csv"`,
91	    },
92	  })
93	}
94

1	/**
2	 * GET  /api/settings/payments/tax-registrations  — list studio's tax registrations
3	 * POST /api/settings/payments/tax-registrations  — add a new registration via Stripe
4	 *
5	 * §S13.3 — stripe_tax_registrations and stripe_connected_accounts are not yet
6	 * in generated types.ts (Dato migration pending). Queries use untyped
7	 * SupabaseClient (no Database generic) with `data as unknown as T` casts.
8	 */
9	import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
10	import { z } from 'zod'
11	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
12	import { createClient, getAuthenticatedUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
13	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
14	import { createStripeTaxRegistration } from '@/lib/stripe/tax-registrations'
15	import { logAuditAction } from '@/lib/audit'
16	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
17	import type { StripeTaxRegistrationRow } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
18	
19	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	// §S13.3 typed helpers — untyped SupabaseClient avoids types.ts column gap
21	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22	
23	interface ConnectedAccountPartial {
24	  account_id: string
25	}
26	
27	/** §S13.3 — stripe_connected_accounts not yet in generated types. */
28	async function fetchConnectedAccountId(
29	  db: SupabaseClient,
30	  studioId: string,
31	): Promise<string | null> {
32	  const { data, error } = await db
33	    .from('stripe_connected_accounts')
34	    .select('account_id')
35	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
36	    .eq('type', 'studio')
37	    .eq('onboarding_status', 'active')
38	    .single()
39	  if (error || !data) return null
40	  return (data as unknown as ConnectedAccountPartial).account_id
41	}
42	
43	/** §S13.3 — stripe_tax_registrations not yet in generated types. */
44	async function fetchTaxRegistrations(
45	  db: SupabaseClient,
46	  studioId: string,
47	): Promise<StripeTaxRegistrationRow[]> {
48	  const { data, error } = await db
49	    .from('stripe_tax_registrations')
50	    .select('*')
51	    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
52	    .order('active_from', { ascending: false })
53	  if (error || !data) return []
54	  return data as unknown as StripeTaxRegistrationRow[]
55	}
56	
57	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	// POST body schema
59	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60	
61	const PostBodySchema = z.object({
62	  country: z.string().length(2, 'Country must be a two-letter ISO 3166 code.').toUpperCase(),
63	  state: z.string().min(1).max(10).toUpperCase().optional(),
64	  /** ISO date string e.g. '2026-05-01'. Defaults to today when absent. */
65	  activeFromIso: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, 'activeFromIso must be YYYY-MM-DD.').optional(),
66	})
67	
68	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	// GET
70	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
71	
72	export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
73	  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'unknown'
74	  const rl = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
75	  if (!rl.success) {
76	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests.' }, { status: 429 })
77	  }
78	
79	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
80	  if (!auth) {
81	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized.' }, { status: 401 })
82	  }
83	
84	  if (auth.role !== 'owner' && auth.role !== 'admin') {
85	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Owner or admin role required.' }, { status: 403 })
86	  }
87	
88	  const supabase = await createClient()
89	
90	  try {
91	    // §S13.3 — cast supabase to untyped SupabaseClient for unregistered table
92	    const registrations = await fetchTaxRegistrations(supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient, auth.studioId)
93	    return NextResponse.json({ registrations })
94	  } catch (err) {
95	    logger.error({ err, studioId: auth.studioId }, 'tax-registrations GET: query failed')
96	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Could not load tax registrations.' }, { status: 500 })
97	  }
98	}
99	
100	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
101	// POST
102	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
105	  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'unknown'
106	  const rl = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
107	  if (!rl.success) {
108	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests.' }, { status: 429 })
109	  }
110	
111	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
112	  if (!auth) {
113	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized.' }, { status: 401 })
114	  }
115	
116	  if (auth.role !== 'owner' && auth.role !== 'admin') {
117	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Owner or admin role required.' }, { status: 403 })
118	  }
119	
120	  let body: z.infer<typeof PostBodySchema>
121	  try {
122	    const raw: unknown = await req.json()
123	    body = PostBodySchema.parse(raw)
124	  } catch (err) {
125	    const message = err instanceof z.ZodError
126	      ? err.errors.map((e) => e.message).join(' ')
127	      : 'Invalid request body.'
128	    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 400 })
129	  }
130	
131	  const supabase = await createClient()
132	  // §S13.3 — cast to untyped for unregistered tables
133	  const untypedDb = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient
134	
135	  const connectedAccountId = await fetchConnectedAccountId(untypedDb, auth.studioId)
136	  if (!connectedAccountId) {
137	    return NextResponse.json(
138	      { error: 'No active connected account found for this studio.' },
139	      { status: 422 },
140	    )
141	  }
142	
143	  const activeFromUnixSec = body.activeFromIso
144	    ? Math.floor(new Date(body.activeFromIso).getTime() / 1000)
145	    : Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
146	
147	  try {
148	    const result = await createStripeTaxRegistration(untypedDb, auth.studioId, {
149	      connectedAccountId,
150	      country: body.country,
151	      state: body.state ?? null,
152	      activeFromUnixSec,
153	    })
154	
155	    await logAuditAction(
156	      auth.user.id,
157	      'tax_registration_added',
158	      { type: 'stripe_tax_registration', id: result.registrationId },
159	      { jurisdiction: result.jurisdiction, status: result.status },
160	      auth.studioId,
161	    )
162	
163	    return NextResponse.json({ registration_id: result.registrationId }, { status: 201 })
164	  } catch (err) {
165	    logger.error({ err, studioId: auth.studioId }, 'tax-registrations POST: create failed')
166	    return NextResponse.json(
167	      { error: 'Could not create tax registration. Check the country and state.' },
168	      { status: 500 },
169	    )
170	  }
171	}

1	/**
2	 * PATCH /api/settings/payments/tip-pool
3	 *
4	 * Owner/admin-only endpoint: toggle the studio's tip routing mode.
5	 *
6	 * Auth:  owner | admin (receptionists and artists cannot change this setting).
7	 * Rate:  authedRatelimit (60 req/min per IP).
8	 *
9	 * Body:  { enabled: boolean }
10	 *
11	 * Flow:
12	 *   1. Auth + studio role check (owner/admin only).
13	 *   2. Rate limit.
14	 *   3. Zod body validation.
15	 *   4. Read current value for audit delta.
16	 *   5. Update studios.tip_pool_enabled via service-role client (RLS restricts direct write).
17	 *   6. Audit log: tip_pool_mode_changed.
18	 *   7. Return 200 { tip_pool_enabled: boolean }.
19	 *
20	 * Success:    200 { tip_pool_enabled: boolean }
21	 * Forbidden:  403 { error }
22	 * Validation: 400 { error, issues }
23	 * Server err: 500 { error }
24	 */
25	
26	import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
27	import { z } from 'zod'
28	import { createClient, createServiceRoleClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
29	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
30	import { getClientIp } from '@/lib/rate-limit/get-client-ip'
31	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
32	import { logAuditAction } from '@/lib/audit'
33	
34	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
35	// Constants
36	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
37	
38	const ALLOWED_ROLES = ['owner', 'admin'] as const
39	type AllowedRole = typeof ALLOWED_ROLES[number]
40	
41	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	// Input schema
43	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	
45	const TipPoolBodySchema = z.object({
46	  enabled: z.boolean(),
47	})
48	
49	type TipPoolBody = z.infer<typeof TipPoolBodySchema>
50	
51	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	// Route handler
53	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54	
55	export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
56	  // 1. Rate limit
57	  const ip = getClientIp(req)
58	  const { success: rateLimitOk } = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
59	  if (!rateLimitOk) {
60	    return Response.json({ error: 'Rate limited' }, { status: 429 })
61	  }
62	
63	  // 2. Auth — session-scoped client
64	  const supabase = await createClient()
65	  const {
66	    data: { user },
67	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
68	  if (!user) {
69	    return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
70	  }
71	
72	  // 3. Resolve studio membership + role (owner/admin only)
73	  const { data: member, error: memberErr } = await supabase
74	    .from('studio_members')
75	    .select('studio_id, role')
76	    .eq('user_id', user.id)
77	    .is('deactivated_at', null)
78	    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
79	    .limit(1)
80	    .single()
81	
82	  if (memberErr || !member) {
83	    return Response.json({ error: 'No active studio membership' }, { status: 403 })
84	  }
85	
86	  const role = member.role as string
87	  if (!(ALLOWED_ROLES as readonly string[]).includes(role)) {
88	    return Response.json(
89	      { error: 'Only studio owners and admins can change tip routing.' },
90	      { status: 403 },
91	    )
92	  }
93	
94	  const studioId: string = member.studio_id
95	
96	  // 4. Parse + validate body
97	  let body: TipPoolBody
98	  try {
99	    const raw = await req.json()
100	    body = TipPoolBodySchema.parse(raw)
101	  } catch (err) {
102	    if (err instanceof z.ZodError) {
103	      return Response.json({ error: 'Validation failed', issues: err.issues }, { status: 400 })
104	    }
105	    return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, { status: 400 })
106	  }
107	
108	  // 5. Read current value for audit delta
109	  // §S13.3 — tip_pool_enabled column added by Track C migration; cast through unknown.
110	  const { data: currentRow, error: readErr } = await supabase
111	    .from('studios')
112	    .select('tip_pool_enabled')
113	    .eq('id', studioId)
114	    .single()
115	
116	  if (readErr) {
117	    logger.error({ studio_id: studioId, err: readErr }, 'tip-pool: failed to read current value')
118	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to read current tip routing setting.' }, { status: 500 })
119	  }
120	
121	  const currentEnabled =
122	    (currentRow as unknown as { tip_pool_enabled: boolean | null }).tip_pool_enabled === true
123	
124	  // 6. Update via service-role client (bypass RLS for this settings write)
125	  const serviceSupabase = createServiceRoleClient()
126	  // §S13.3 — tip_pool_enabled added by Track C migration; cast through unknown to bypass
127	  // generated types until pnpm db:types is rerun after Track C migration lands.
128	  const { error: updateErr } = await serviceSupabase
129	    .from('studios')
130	    .update({ tip_pool_enabled: body.enabled } as unknown as Parameters<
131	      ReturnType<typeof serviceSupabase.from>['update']
132	    >[0])
133	    .eq('id', studioId)
134	
135	  if (updateErr) {
136	    logger.error(
137	      { studio_id: studioId, enabled: body.enabled, err: updateErr },
138	      'tip-pool: failed to update studios.tip_pool_enabled',
139	    )
140	    return Response.json({ error: 'Failed to update tip routing setting.' }, { status: 500 })
141	  }
142	
143	  // 7. Audit log (non-fatal)
144	  await logAuditAction(
145	    user.id,
146	    'tip_pool_mode_changed',
147	    { type: 'studio', id: studioId },
148	    {
149	      from: currentEnabled,
150	      to: body.enabled,
151	      by: user.id,
152	      role: role as AllowedRole,
153	    },
154	    studioId,
155	  )
156	
157	  logger.info(
158	    { studio_id: studioId, from: currentEnabled, to: body.enabled, user_id: user.id },
159	    'tip pool mode changed',
160	  )
161	
162	  return Response.json({ tip_pool_enabled: body.enabled })
163	}
164

70	export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest, context: RouteContext) {
71	  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ?? 'unknown'
72	  const rl = await authedRatelimit.limit(ip)
73	  if (!rl.success) {
74	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests.' }, { status: 429 })
75	  }
76	
77	  const auth = await getAuthenticatedUser()
78	  if (!auth) {
79	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized.' }, { status: 401 })
80	  }
81	
82	  if (auth.role !== 'owner' && auth.role !== 'admin') {
83	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Owner or admin role required.' }, { status: 403 })
84	  }
85	
86	  const { id: registrationId } = await context.params
87	
88	  const supabase = await createClient()
89	  // §S13.3 — cast to untyped for unregistered tables + RPC
90	  const untypedDb = supabase as unknown as SupabaseClient
91	
92	  const connectedAccountId = await fetchConnectedAccountId(untypedDb, auth.studioId)
93	  if (!connectedAccountId) {
94	    return NextResponse.json(
95	      { error: 'No active connected account found for this studio.' },
96	      { status: 422 },
97	    )
98	  }
99	
100	  // Verify the registration belongs to this studio (RLS check via session client)
101	  const regRow = await fetchTaxRegistrationRow(untypedDb, auth.studioId, registrationId)
102	  if (!regRow) {
103	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tax registration not found.' }, { status: 404 })
104	  }
105	
106	  try {
107	    // Expire on Stripe
108	    const expireResult = await expireStripeTaxRegistration({
109	      connectedAccountId,
110	      registrationId,
111	    })
112	
113	    // Remove from DB via RPC
114	    const rpcArgs: StripeTaxRegistrationRemoveArgs = {
115	      studioId: auth.studioId,
116	      registrationId,
117	    }
118	
119	    // §S13.3 — stripe_tax_registration_remove not yet in generated RPC types
120	    const { error: rpcError } = await untypedDb.rpc(RPC.STRIPE_TAX_REGISTRATION_REMOVE, {
121	      p_studio_id: rpcArgs.studioId,
122	      p_registration_id: rpcArgs.registrationId,
123	    })
124	
125	    if (rpcError) {
126	      logger.error(
127	        { err: rpcError, registrationId, studioId: auth.studioId },
128	        'tax-registrations DELETE: RPC remove failed',
129	      )
130	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Could not remove tax registration from records.' }, { status: 500 })
131	    }
132	
133	    await logAuditAction(
134	      auth.user.id,
135	      'tax_registration_removed',
136	      { type: 'stripe_tax_registration', id: regRow.id },
137	      { registration_id: registrationId, status: expireResult.status },
138	      auth.studioId,
139	    )
140	
141	    return NextResponse.json({ id: registrationId, status: 'expired' })
142	  } catch (err) {

144	    return NextResponse.json(
